name: estacao-ai
description: Long-term memory across sessions and harnesses. Hands each lifecycle event to the installed estacao-ai binary, which applies your capture exclusions and sends a sanitized record only to your estacao-ai server (default http://127.0.0.1:49374). Adds the estacao-ai MCP tools. No telemetry. Requires the estacao-ai binary, 3.0 or later. In Cowork, capture runs on your computer and needs estacao-ai installed there; the memory tools still work.

server_url.title: estacao-ai server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the estacao-ai server. Leave empty to use the server_url from your estacao-ai config (http://127.0.0.1:49374 for a local install).

ai_memory_bin.title: estacao-ai executable
ai_memory_bin.description: Absolute path to the estacao-ai binary, only needed when it is not on PATH. A relative path is ignored.

data_dir.title: estacao-ai data directory
data_dir.description: Only for an install that uses a non-default data directory.
